blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has declared special non-working days in Tawi-Tawi, the municipality of Lumban in Laguna, and 17 municipalities in Camarines Sur and Masbate for their respective anniversary and cultural celebrations.
